decision: ROUND 7 IS MADE WITH MOSS ONLY, as rounds 5 and 6 were. The owner decided on 2026-11-16: "Lass uns mit MOSS weiter machen, ohne Stable Audio. Ich denke damit kommen wir auch ans Ziel." No Stable Audio file is generated, screened or published. This decision wins over any brief that says otherwise.
note: Round 7: the two families that are still open after round 6 (assets/audio/rounds/round6-ratings.json: of 14 candidates 4 fit, 2 close, 8 wrong), the thruster pulse and the shield hit. Everything else he has accepted: hull hits light, medium and heavy, the gear, the fold jump and the fold exit. The round is built around the two candidates he called close, because new prompts have landed less than one time in three. His notes of 2026-11-18, word for word. On ev6_2_thruster_mighty_2_moss_p3s11 (close): "Es waren nur zwei statt Drei Schüsse wie im Prompt gewünscht. Grundsätzlich gut. Wenn wir noch ein bisschen Raumklang reinbringen, sind wir langsam am Ziel". On ev6_3_shield_tight_2_moss_p2s11 (close): "Es wird besser, ich würde den Ton vielleicht leicht heller machen als bisher, aber die Idee, dass der Schild ein Projektil oder einen Energiestrahl \"verschluckt\", und so klingt es hier ein wenig, ist die richtige Richtung". What follows from them. (1) Fixed candidates: the very raw file of each close candidate, processed as he asked: the thruster with a room at two strengths in one channel and as a wide room in two channels ("Raumklang" can mean reverberation or width, so both are offered), the shield a little brighter in two ways (tuned higher, and with more highs). A fixed candidate is always on the page; no pick rule, hand skip or exclusion applies to it. (2) New generations beside them: the thruster prompt he called good in principle, asked for 4 s so that three shots fit (the raw file of round 6 was 2 s long and holds two shots 1.0 s apart, so the third did not fit; the cut was not the cause), and the same prompt in a steel hangar; the shield as something that swallows a projectile or a beam, brighter. The page text of every thruster candidate says how many separate shots were measured in the file, because his remark was that text and file did not match. The page already sends every sound through the cabin impulse response (0.5 s long, fully open by default; his slider lives in his browser), so the baked room is made clearly longer than that. After the first check of the round (2026-11-18, before he had rated anything of it) the plan was changed in five places, all written in the families' "what": a fourth fixed thruster with three shots, a third fixed shield, a floor of 40 % of the energy above 60 Hz for the two generated thruster families, no pressed-noise fallback for shield_absorb, and one hand skip (tools/sound/skips7.json: a click in the tail of shield_snap seed 22).
